idea-plugin.name: Workspace Source Redirector
idea-plugin.description:
Redirects Java go-to-declaration (Ctrl+Click / Ctrl+B) and go-to-implementation (Ctrl+Alt+B) to the matching project sources inside the same workspace instead of decompiled jars.
解决 IDEA 同工作区多 Java 项目互引时,Ctrl+点击 / Ctrl+B 总是跳到本地仓库 jar(或反编译类)的问题。
只要工作区里有同名类的项目源码,就按类的全限定名重定向到项目源码,不要求依赖版本与源码一致。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.0

  • Rebuilt with the IntelliJ Platform Gradle Plugin; bytecode now targets Java 8.
  • Compatible with IntelliJ IDEA 2023.1 (build 231) and later, with no upper version bound.
  • Core behavior unchanged: go-to-declaration and go-to-implementation redirect to workspace sources.
